hints: The queue is just an array with two indices: head and tail. head < tail means 'not empty'. No wraparound needed - each vertex is enqueued at most once, so MAXV slots are always enough.
Append u to order[] when you DEQUEUE it, and mark neighbours visited when you ENQUEUE them.
If you mark visited on dequeue instead of on enqueue, a vertex with two in-edges gets queued twice and appears twice in the output.
title: BFS visit order
